composition_label: Feedback analysis -> Knowledge-base answers -> Guided setup -> Normal research

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: One object with schema_version, fixture_label, feedback, themes, knowledge_base, setup_steps, completed_step_ids and research_sources. Unknown fields and duplicate identifiers are rejected. IDs are scoped to their collections; passage IDs to each source.
shared_schema.citation: collection, source_id, passage_id, start, end, quote; offsets are zero-based Python Unicode character indexes, end exclusive
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, fixture_label, ordered stages, progress; errors have schema_version, status=error and error
shared_schema.validation: Shared object, collection, type, identifier, dependency, citation, extractive-text and stage validation. Every stage validates its predecessor before consumption and its own output before return.

cross_stage_handoffs: feedback -> faq: deduplicated feedback records supply classified themes, query evidence and traceable upstream IDs
faq -> guided: answered theme records unlock steps; absent evidence and abstention block steps; FAQ citations propagate
guided -> normal: validated ready/completed steps supply research queries; blocked steps explicitly abstain without retrieval

behavior.fixtures: All example entities, support passages and research findings are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.feedback: Casefold and whitespace-normalized exact deduplication; first original excerpt retained with every duplicate feedback ID. Keyword token-set matching permits multiple themes and preserves unclassified records.
behavior.retrieval: Casefolded Unicode alphanumeric token overlap excluding fixed stopwords; a positive overlap is required; highest score wins, then source ID and passage ID lexicographically. Titles are not retrieval evidence.
behavior.faq: One verbatim best passage per observed theme, or explicit abstention. Lexical relevance does not guarantee that a passage semantically answers every aspect of a question.
behavior.guided: Acyclic prerequisites, deterministic topological order, explicit user-declared completion and progress counts. Ready is not completed. Unsupported or prerequisite-inconsistent completion is rejected. Empty workflow is fully complete.
behavior.normal: One exact source passage per eligible step or explicit abstention with reason; full provenance follows upstream IDs back to original feedback.
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; success exits 0; validation, JSON decoding, text decoding and file errors exit 2. No network, provider or callable model is used.
behavior.progress_persistence: Completion is round-tripped explicitly through completed_step_ids; no hidden state or automatic completion.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status ok, four ordered stages, exit 0 and empty stderr
test_outcomes.validation_errors: Verified malformed JSON, invalid schema, missing file and missing argument produce JSON status error and exit 2
